board_evidence.warnings_note: dmesg.before/after added lines are listed per case as warnings in board-audit.json; a zero taint bit is not a statement that no warning exists

fixed_checks.note: each run independently re-checks the research magic, observer magic, E2 mode/FREEZE phase, zero error/overflow counters, snapshot_valid/target_valid/fp_done, IDMA2CAP F00..F03, the IDMAE2T1 D80..D8F block and its d87/d88/d8b identities, the F10 reverse readback, the frozen input envelope, metadata exit/taint/argv and the declared record sha256; plus the board capture (board/record.json == record.json, exit.txt, taint.before/after, uname before/after vs kernel_release, argv.txt vs plan and metadata, stderr, dmesg before/after added lines, record.sha256/archive.sha256 first token, and the archive members against the local board files)

limits.statistics: descriptive count/min/median/max only; short cases are single runs and boundary has 5 runs per condition, so no significance, equivalence or novelty claim follows
